project.summary: PickDiff: League draft tool with champion tier lists by role; enter bans and picks to see counters to the whole enemy team; draft (1vs5) or role (1vs1) scoring, meta and composition settings, Solo queue or Tournament draft formats. Not endorsed by Riot Games.

about.text: PickDiff: League draft tool with champion tier lists by role; enter bans and picks to see counters to the whole enemy team; draft (1vs5) or role (1vs1) scoring, meta and composition settings, Solo queue or Tournament draft formats. Not endorsed by Riot Games.
Live League of Legends draft assistant. Enter bans and picks to see which champion counters the enemy team, ranked by real matchup and win-rate data.
